name: spine-agent-guide-drift-check
body:
Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.agent-guide-drift-check drove only domain.value.agent-guide and domain.value.library-agent-guide; because `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, the spine dead-ended before any solution or code. Added `drives` -> domain.group.authoring (owns the deck-guide value domain.value.agent-guide and the scaffold writers) and `drives` -> domain.group.templating (owns the library-guide value domain.value.library-agent-guide); both groups realise solution.component.agent-guide. The existing `drives` to the two value nodes are kept.

SUPERSEDED: the original completion added `implemented-by` solution.component.agent-guide -> internal/scaffold.TestAgentGuidesMatchFormat, the build/test-time self-test that fails when either embedded guide drifts from the implemented format, and recorded the path as agent-guide-drift-check -> authoring/templating -> agent-guide -> internal/scaffold.TestAgentGuidesMatchFormat. That anchor is stale: a production component must not anchor test code, as recorded in requirements.note.agent-guide-test-anchor-removed (which also withdrew the later feedback-11 re-anchoring of internal/scaffold/agentsguide_test.go).

CURRENT PATH TO CODE: agent-guide-drift-check -> domain.group.authoring and domain.group.templating (both realised-by solution.component.agent-guide, implemented-by the production guide writers internal/scaffold.Init, scaffold.InitExternal, scaffold.InitLibrary and scaffold.writeHelloSeed, the file internal/scaffold/libraryguide.go, and the two guide sources internal/scaffold/seed/AGENTS.md and internal/scaffold/libraryguide/AGENTS.md) and, via domain.group.templating, solution.component.template-registry and solution.component.renderer (the format code the guides document and the self-test checks against). Every Requirement -> Drives -> Domain -> RealisedBy -> Solution -> SpecImplementedBy -> code row resolves to production (non-test) code; no row reaches only test code.
